+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboTwin 2.0 place_dual_shoes controller (eai-standard/2.1).
+
+The controller uses only camera observations and robot proprioception.  The
+source TCP centers were estimated from the calibrated overhead image; inspect
+each saved image and proprioception record before advancing a manual stage.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import EpisodeOver, Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output/place_dual_shoes")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+# Downward approach: tool x points down; gripper closes along world x.
+Q_PICK = np.array([0.5, 0.5, 0.5, -0.5], dtype=float)
+# Same downward approach, rotated +90 degrees around world z.  This rotates
+# a shoe whose toe initially points +y so its toe points -x (left).
+Q_LEFT = np.array([2**-0.5, 0.0, 2**-0.5, 0.0], dtype=float)
+
+# TCP centers from the overhead image, in table coordinates.
+SOURCE = {
+    "left": (-0.27, -0.08),
+    "right": (0.21, -0.10),
+}
+DEST = {
+    "left": (0.0, -0.16),
+    "right": (0.0, -0.075),
+}
+
+
+def rot_x(q):
+    w, x, y, z = q
+    return np.array([
+        [1 - 2 * (y*y + z*z), 2 * (x*y - z*w), 2 * (x*z + y*w)],
+        [2 * (x*y + z*w), 1 - 2 * (x*x + z*z), 2 * (y*z - x*w)],
+        [2 * (x*z - y*w), 2 * (y*z + x*w), 1 - 2 * (x*x + y*y)],
+    ])[:, 0]
+
+
+def pose(tcp, q, grip):
+    """Convert desired gripper-center pose to the service's EE-frame pose."""
+    tcp = np.asarray(tcp, dtype=float)
+    ee = tcp - 0.12 * rot_x(q)
+    return np.r_[ee, q, grip]
+
+
+def state(robot):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    return obs, now
+
+
+def execute(robot, stage, updates):
+    """Submit one waypoint, preserving the uncommanded arm's measured pose."""
+    obs, now = state(robot)
+    row = np.r_[now[14:21], now[28], now[21:28], now[29]].astype(np.float32)
+    for arm, tcp, q, grip in updates:
+        part = pose(tcp, q, grip)
+        if arm == "left":
+            row[:8] = part
+        else:
+            row[8:] = part
+    res = robot.submit(
+        "ee_pose", row, video="frames", video_fps=5,
+        cameras=("head_camera", "observer_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"),
+        note=f"place_dual_shoes:{stage}",
+    )
+    res.save(str(OUT / stage))
+    _, now2 = state(robot)
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "stage": stage,
+        "meta": res.meta,
+        "ee_pose": now2[14:28].tolist(),
+        "gripper_measured": [float(now2[36]), float(now2[43])],
+        "tcp_pose": now2[56:70].tolist(),
+        "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+    }, indent=2))
+    return now2
+
+
+def run_stage(robot, stage):
+    if stage == "prep":
+        execute(robot, stage, [
+            ("left", (*SOURCE["left"], 0.90), Q_PICK, 1.0),
+            ("right", (*SOURCE["right"], 0.90), Q_PICK, 1.0),
+        ])
+        return
+    if stage.startswith("pick-"):
+        arm = stage.split("-", 1)[1]
+        xy = SOURCE[arm]
+        execute(robot, stage, [(arm, (*xy, 0.79), Q_PICK, 0.0)])
+        return
+    if stage.startswith("lift-"):
+        arm = stage.split("-", 1)[1]
+        xy = SOURCE[arm]
+        execute(robot, stage, [(arm, (*xy, 0.95), Q_PICK, 0.0)])
+        return
+    if stage.startswith("carry-"):
+        arm = stage.split("-", 1)[1]
+        xy = DEST[arm]
+        execute(robot, stage, [(arm, (*xy, 0.95), Q_LEFT, 0.0)])
+        return
+    if stage.startswith("drop-"):
+        arm = stage.split("-", 1)[1]
+        xy = DEST[arm]
+        execute(robot, stage, [(arm, (*xy, 0.80), Q_LEFT, 1.0)])
+        return
+    if stage.startswith("park-"):
+        arm = stage.split("-", 1)[1]
+        xy = SOURCE[arm]
+        execute(robot, stage, [(arm, (*xy, 0.98), Q_PICK, 1.0)])
+        return
+    raise ValueError(stage)
+
+
+def run_all(robot):
+    for stage in (
+        "prep", "pick-left", "lift-left", "carry-left", "drop-left", "park-left",
+        "pick-right", "lift-right", "carry-right", "drop-right", "park-right",
+    ):
+        run_stage(robot, stage)
+        # A closed gripper stays measurably open when it holds a shoe.  Stop
+        # before transport if the current grasp did not take.
+        if stage in ("pick-left", "pick-right"):
+            _, now = state(robot)
+            measured = float(now[36] if stage.endswith("left") else now[43])
+            if measured < 0.025:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"No shoe detected in {stage}; measured gripper={measured:.4f}")
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--stage", default="all", choices=[
+        "all", "prep", "pick-left", "lift-left", "carry-left", "drop-left", "park-left",
+        "pick-right", "lift-right", "carry-right", "drop-right", "park-right",
+    ])
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    robot = Robot()
+    print("connected", robot.base)
+    if args.stage == "all":
+        run_all(robot)
+    else:
+        run_stage(robot, args.stage)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        main()
+    except EpisodeOver as exc:
+        print(f"episode ended: {exc}")
*** End Patch";
